mapper.select: select INDENTIFY_MARK as indentifyMark, CASE WHEN MAX(CNY_AMT) < 6000000 THEN '02' ELSE '03' END holderType from chb_investhold_info_sub where HOLD_DATE=to_date(#{excuteDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND CNY_AMT>1000000 GROUP BY INDENTIFY_MARK

SELECT sub.INDENTIFY_MARK AS indentifyMark, tmp.HOLDER_TYPE AS holderType, sub.SUBMIT_STATUS AS submitStatus, sub.STATUS AS status from CHB_EQU_SUB sub inner join chb_equ_type_tmp tmp on sub.INDENTIFY_MARK=tmp.INDENTIFY_MARK and sub.HOLDER_TYPE != tmp.HOLDER_TYPE where sub.STATUS in ('01','02')
